name: Fiberon PPS-GF20 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.4 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 250 mm/s.
Hotend 310 C+ and hardened nozzle. No heated chamber required; TDS chamber room temp, wiki ambient 25-80 C. Fan OFF. UL94 V0 at 1.5 mm. Water absorption 0.11%; dry 100 C/10 h if damp. Brittle on spool: clear filament path (works in Bambu AMS per wiki). Grey; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12.
